name: graphrag
description_en: A modular graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system
readme_excerpt: GraphRAG > [!WARNING] > GraphRAG is a research project that explores the functional use of graphs to form a targeted context for question answering. Since our first release in July 2024 the capabilities of frontier models have changed dramatically, and our portfolio of research projects has diversified to match.
